diagram_title: bodesign R13 compute/landing split + WebDAV working-cache

activities.title: Serve C00-C07 lifecycle via split planes
activities.description: Serve the C00-C07 PCB lifecycle with deterministic repo-local verbs executed on the host (landing plane) and heavy EDA compute in the container (compute plane), exchanging bulk files through a per-deliverable WebDAV working cache

activities.title: Route verb by locality
activities.description: Classify a verb as landing vs compute vs cache-lifecycle per mcp.json R13.5 declarations; unknown verbs return typed VERB_UNKNOWN

activities.title: Execute landing verb on host
activities.description: gate.py assembles PYTHONPATH over packages/*, runs the deterministic pure-python verb against --repo, writes directly into the caller repo, emits JSON envelope or typed LANDING_* error

activities.title: Execute heavy compute in container
activities.description: Container tool (pcbnew/kicad-cli/ngspice/OpenSCAD/pyrender/LibreOffice/freerouting) reads a token or cache-namespace tree and produces heavy artifacts under the R2 token contract

activities.title: Provision and serve WebDAV cache
activities.description: Find-or-mint a per-deliverable cache token; report explicit host_provision state (R14.5); mint credential only on opt-in issue_webdav_credential (R14.6, rotate-on-issue); dispatch class-2 DAV methods under AuthProvider Basic identity with traversal/size/lock guards

activities.title: Export cache to truth store and close
activities.description: Land the cache tree into the caller's authoritative folder (typed EXPORT_TARGET_UNREACHABLE on bad target), stamp last_export_at, close behind the dirty-gate (WORKSPACE_CLOSE_DIRTY unless clean or force)
